verdict.rationale: Freshsales' own marketing says it automates repetitive tasks, which points to a native automation capability. However, the evidence never describes defining rules, event triggers, or the resulting actions. Lead routing via Freddy AI is related but not the same as user-defined rules. Missing for 10: documentation of a rule/workflow builder, event-trigger types, configurable actions and conditions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Eliminate manual effort and save time by automating repetitive, mundane tasks.
capture, qualify, route, and track them with the power of Freddy AI.
